commands.review_summary:
The PR recognizes Loom share/embed URLs for generic yt-dlp transcription, tightens audio selection and failure handling, and adds Loom-specific CLI/core, Firecrawl, Chrome/daemon, documentation, and regression-test behavior.

Reproducibility: yes. at source level: current main has no Loom media classification in the generic transcript provider, and the canonical issue supplies a concrete CLI command producing `generic/not_implemented`. This read-only review did not run artifact-producing tests.

target.title: fix: support Loom transcript extraction
target.body:
## Summary

- recognize strict Loom share/embed video URLs as media-like inputs for CLI/core transcript routing
- route Loom through the existing generic yt-dlp transcription pipeline
- ensure audio transcription cannot select a video-only fallback
- reject explicit `--video-mode transcript` Loom failures as a real CLI/non-zero failure (not empty successful extract content with the error only in diagnostics)
- prefer-mode still discovers embedded captions from Loom HTML before yt-dlp, without returning landing-page text
- disable shared embedded-YouTube URL substitution during Loom caption HTML discovery
- always pass the original Loom share/embed URL to yt-dlp (never embedded CDN renditions)
- harden Loom URL matching against nonstandard ports, credentials, and uppercase IDs
- do **not** hard-prefer Loom in the shared `shouldPreferUrlMode(...)` policy used by Chrome/daemon auto routing
- Chrome/daemon: do not infer video/url/slides/timestamps from Loom page media flags unless video input is explicit
- AUTO HTML/Firecrawl: do **not** advertise Loom share URL as `video.kind: "direct"` (prefer/transcript-only still does, for yt-dlp identity)
- same-ID redirect/metadata: pass `htmlBaseUrl` for relative caption resolution; cross-ID / conflicting metadata discards foreign HTML (and Firecrawl markdown)
- add focused regression coverage and documentation

## Root cause

1. Loom share/embed URLs were not classified as known media URLs for CLI/core transcript routing, so the generic transcript provider could return `generic/not_implemented` for public Loom pages.
2. The shared yt-dlp audio selector allowed unconstrained `best` fallbacks. For hosts with split HLS (including Loom), that can resolve to a video-only rendition and fail with `Media has no audio stream`.
3. Even after Loom routing, explicit prefer-mode transcript failures could fall through the HTML pipeline and surface Loom landing-page text as successful extract output.
4. Embedded/og:video CDN URLs could replace the Loom share URL before yt-dlp, risking video-only signed renditions.
5. The URL extraction session treated all `shouldPreferUrlMode` failures as best-effort URL-only empty successes. Because Loom was briefly prefer-url-mode, CLI prefer failures were swallowed into empty successful extracts with the real error buried in diagnostics.
6. The Loom prefer transcript-only strategy initially called `resolveTranscriptForLink(url, null, ...)`, so embedded `<track kind="captions|subtitles">` discovery never ran on the real prefer path.
7. Passing Loom HTML into `resolveTranscriptForLink` without disabling embedded YouTube substitution allowed incidental YouTube iframes to replace the Loom URL before the generic provider ran.
8. Including Loom in the shared `shouldPreferUrlMode(...)` helper hard-routed Chrome/daemon requests into URL/video extraction even though guarded daemon URL flows intentionally disable yt-dlp for unresolved URLs.
9. AUTO extracts advertising `{ kind: "direct", url: loomShareUrl }` made thin Loom pages look like downloadable media (`isVideoOnly` / `loadRemoteAsset` / slides).
10. Firecrawl Loom caption bases ignored metadata final URLs, and conflicting Loom IDs in Firecrawl metadata could still trust foreign HTML.

## Implementation

- Added `isLoomVideoUrl` / `isSameLoomRecording` with structured URL parsing for `http(s)://loom.com|www.loom.com` `share`/`embed` paths and a lowercase 32-hex video id.
- Generic transcript provider attempts Loom transcription in `auto` and `prefer`, always with the original Loom URL (`mediaKind: "video"`, `service: "generic"`).
- Prefer-mode Loom entry in `TRANSCRIPT_ONLY_STRATEGIES`: cache-before-HTML, same-ID `htmlBaseUrl`, `embeddedMediaUrl: null`, failures throw.
- AUTO HTML path: pin original Loom URL, same-ID `htmlBaseUrl` / discard foreign HTML on cross-ID redirect, disable YouTube substitution, set `video: null`.
- Firecrawl path: same YouTube/video-null policy; `htmlBaseUrl` from same-ID metadata (`url`/`ogUrl` preferred over `sourceURL`); conflicting Loom IDs discard HTML/markdown/metadata text.
- Chrome: daemon suppress for implicit Loom video mode; slides-seed gated to explicit `inputMode: "video"`.
- Constrained `DEFAULT_AUDIO_FORMAT` so every combined `best` fallback requires `[acodec!=none]`.
- Docs/changelog updates. Guarded-daemon external-downloader policy unchanged.

## Verification

```text
Focused Loom / Chrome / sidepanel / Firecrawl suite (post-polish):
  tests/link-preview.loom-*.test.ts
  tests/chrome.panel-summarize*.test.ts
  tests/sidepanel.slides-seed-policy.test.ts
  tests/chrome.daemon-payload.test.ts
  tests/chrome.media-extraction-plan.test.ts
  tests/link-preview.media-transcript-prefer.test.ts
  tests/transcript.generic.video-tag.test.ts
  tests/content.url.test.ts
# → 12 files / 89+ tests passed (broader focused run); loom-auto alone 9 passed

pnpm -s check
# → format, lint, typecheck, and coverage gates passed (HEAD 2ca44d4b)

Reviews before push:
- ponytail-review (complexity)
- thermo-nuclear + code-quality
- code-reviewer
- security-review (Firecrawl htmlBaseUrl / video.kind trust)
# Medium Firecrawl metadata-conflict gap fixed in 80da4e46 / 2ca44d4b
```

## Live behaviour proof

Public fixture: `https://www.loom.com/share/ef3224a48a084371bd6d766ee81f083f` (~51 min)

**yt-dlp extractor / audio-capable selection** (earlier on this PR):

```text
$ yt-dlp --print '%(extractor)s|%(id)s|%(duration)s' --skip-download <loom-url>
loom|ef3224a48a084371bd6d766ee81f083f|3076
```

**Built CLI: explicit prefer failure is a real reject** (no transcription provider):

```text
# exit=1
Failed to transcribe Loom video (... Missing transcription provider ...)
```

**Live end-to-end transcription: still blocked**

On the finish pass for HEAD `2ca44d4b`, no transcription backend was available in the agent environment (GROQ / OPENAI / ASSEMBLYAI / GEMINI / FAL / DEEPGRAM keys absent; whisper.cpp absent; `op` absent). Deterministic unit/integration coverage proves successful `generic` + `yt-dlp` transcript shaping when a provider is configured, and caption-discovery / redirect-trust / Chrome-suppress regressions are green.

ClawSweeper clearance for live transcript success still needs a key from Kartik (or a short public Loom + configured provider).

## Security

Raw Loom URLs were not allowed to bypass the daemon’s guarded fetch/external-downloader boundary. Firecrawl metadata URLs used as `htmlBaseUrl` must pass `isSameLoomRecording` (Loom host + same 32-hex id). Cross-ID / conflicting metadata discards foreign HTML. AUTO `video: null` avoids treating share HTML as direct media.

Fixes #353
